description: Google Slides editing. Actions: create_presentation(title), add_slide(presentation_id, layout?, index?), insert_text(presentation_id, object_id, text, index?), replace_text(presentation_id, find, replace, match_case?). Destructive (confirm:true): delete_slide(presentation_id, slide_object_id). layout is a predefined layout such as BLANK, TITLE, TITLE_AND_BODY (default), SECTION_HEADER.

params.description: Action parameters; destructive actions also need confirm: true

name: slides_admin
